title: Do Multimodal Models Decide Consistently on Equivalent Optical Spectra?
abstract: arXiv:2611.00428v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A spectrum can be given to a model as a table in nanometers or as a plot in photon energy, and the decision should not depend on which one it sees. When the data needed for an answer are missing, the model should say so. We test representation invariance and abstention on measured optical spectra of silicon metasurfaces (MOCLIP) and gold nanoparticles, with labels computed from the data. Each spectrum is shown as four tables (nm, $\mu$m, scientific notation, eV) and two plots (nm, eV), and partial spectra remove data inside or outside the queried range. We evaluate the decision models d3-nano and Jev 1.13, three GPT-6 Luna configurations and the Qwen3.5-2B base model. Changing only the representation moves accuracy by up to 41 percentage points within one model, mostly on photon-energy tables and plots. translated_title: 多模态模型对等价光学光谱的判断是否一致？
translated_abstract: 光谱既可以以纳米为单位以表格形式提供给模型，也可以以光子能量为单位以图形形式呈现，而模型的判断不应取决于它看到的是哪一种表示。当回答所需的数据缺失时，模型应当如实说明。我们在硅超表面（MOCLIP）和金纳米颗粒的实测光学光谱上测试了表征不变性与弃权能力，标签由数据直接计算得出。每条光谱以四种表格（nm、μm、科学计数法、eV）和两种图形（nm、eV）的形式呈现，部分光谱则删除了查询范围内或范围外的数据。我们评估了决策模型 d3-nano 和 Jev 1.13、三种 GPT-6 Luna 配置以及 Qwen3.5-2B 基础模型。结果显示，仅改变表征方式就会使同一模型内的准确率波动高达 41 个百分点，且主要出现在光子能量的表格和图形上。在相同证据下，用光子能量而非波长提问，会使部分“模型-视图”组合的性能提升 16-50 个百分点，而对另一些组合则造成损害（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究通过将同一光学光谱以多种等价表征（不同单位的表格与图形）呈现来测试多模态模型的表征不变性与弃权能力，发现仅改变表征方式就可使模型准确率波动高达41个百分点，表明模型对等价光谱的判断并不一致。
en_tdlr: By presenting the same measured optical spectra as equivalent tables and plots in different units, this study shows that multimodal models lack representation invariance—merely changing the representation shifts accuracy by up to 41 percentage points—revealing inconsistent decisions on equivalent spectra.
